What if your family had superpowers? Dad has super strength. He opens a jar of pickles... and rips the fridge door off.
Who makes these jars so weak?!
Mom has super speed. Dinner is ready before you sit down. So are the dishes. And your homework. All wrong, but very fast.
Your sister can read minds. Everyone's. Especially yours.
You ate the last cookie. I know.
And your superpower? You're invisible. Nobody notices. Same as before.
And that's why your family should never get superpowers.
